beats.say: Your phone has billions of these, and every one is a tiny switch.
A transistor has three legs: base, collector and emitter. A small current into the base controls a much bigger one.
Close the switch, a tiny base current flows, and the transistor lets a much bigger current light the LED.
The collector current is the base current times the gain, often around a hundred.
Next time: the mosfet. Subscribe so you don't miss it.

youtube.hook: There Are Billions of These in Your Phone
youtube.learn: How a transistor works as a switch and amplifier, its base, collector and emitter, and transistor gain.
